outline: This course helps the learners recognize the syntax, style, and organization as far as the papers on English writings are concerned.
schedule:
01 02/19 Intro(research topic)
02 02/26 Endnote and Turnitin (bring your own laptop)
03 03/05 AI tools for Academic writing I(bring your own laptop)
04 03/12 AI tools for Academic writing II(bring your own laptop)
05 03/19 Research- Abstract(Online synchronized class, google meet: https://meet.google.com/hjf-umdt-bkj)
06 03/26 TVET Conference

assessment:
Grading:
1. Attendance 15%
2. Abstract 20%
3. Final Presentation 25%
4. Final Research Paper 40%
- 12 font, 1.5 spaces
- suggest full paper (7 pages)
5. Additional grade 5% (papers are accepted in International journal or conference)
